text:
marta: FYI hitting sustained saturation in us-east GPU pools this morning. Clients report a spike of 429s and some SDKs show no Retry-After. Observed X-Queue-Length on the edge though.
kevin: Thanks — any idea if autoscaler failed to add nodes or if we're at tenant quota?
sanjay: Autoscaler tried but hit cloud quota limits for p4 instance types. So admission control is queuing instead of provisioning. 429s come in two flavors: 1) 429 + Retry-After: <secs>, 2) 429 with admission headers (X-Admission: queued, X-Queue-Length: 42, X-Admission-ETA: 18s).
elaine: On the gateway we started returning those admission headers last week to give richer signals. We didn't fully standardize though; some older frontends still only send plain 429.
kevin: For the SDK we should support both. Minimal behavior: honor Retry-After if present. Best-effort: parse X-Queue-Length and X-Admission-ETA and expose to caller for smarter backoff.
marta: Agreed. Also noticed some clients immediately retry with fixed small sleep which amplifies the storm. Need guidance for jitter/backoff defaults.
sanjay: Proposal for SDK behavior: when 429 received -> parse headers in priority order: Retry-After, X-Admission-ETA, X-Queue-Length. Map into a retry suggestion object: {action: "retry", delay_secs: n, queued: true/false, queue_len: m}. If queue_len > 30 -> prefer larger randomized backoff (exp * jitter) and emit telemetry event.
elaine: Example pseudo-code for parsing and backoff recommendation:
```
headers = response.headers
if headers['Retry-After']:
  delay = int(headers['Retry-After'])
  recommendation = { 'delay': delay, 'type': 'server-specified' }
elif headers['X-Admission-ETA']:
  delay = int(headers['X-Admission-ETA'])
  recommendation = { 'delay': delay, 'type': 'queued' }
else:
  // fall back to client backoff
  recommendation = { 'delay': base * (2 ** attempt) + random_jitter(), 'type': 'client' }
// if X-Queue-Length present, scale jitter up
if headers['X-Queue-Length'] and int(headers['X-Queue-Length']) > 20:
  recommendation['delay'] += random_uniform(0, min(5, int(headers['X-Queue-Length'])/10))
return recommendation
```
kevin: Operational notes: cap retries to 4 for queued responses and prefer linear backoff for queued (e.g., +2s each retry) to avoid eviction of queued requests. For server-specified Retry-After, honor exactly once and then apply a gentler client backoff.
marta: Also ask fleet to emit admission.queue_depth.{region} metric so we can alert when queue depth > 500 for 5m. Right now we only have node CPU/GPU utilization which misses queueing pressure.
sanjay: We'll add one more small header: X-Served-From: shared|dedicated so SDK can surface to users (and hide expensive retries for dedicated customers).
elaine: Edge case: some proxies drop custom headers on redirects — we should ensure the admission headers are set on the final 429 response and not lost.
kevin: For rollout: SDK PR to parse headers + telemetry event + opt-in feature flag to enable queue-aware backoff. Ops will gate the header rollout behind a canary in us-east.
marta: I'll open the SDK PR and the ops ticket. For immediate mitigation, OPS is increasing soft quota and will trigger additional padding for high-traffic customers.
oncall-bot: Incident saved as #1769123456 — tagging current oncall rotation and creating a followup doc in /wiki/incidents. :spiral_note_pad:
kevin: TL;DR for SDK owners: (1) parse Retry-After and X-Admission-* headers, (2) expose a simple retry_recommendation to callers, (3) add capped retries + jitter, (4) emit telemetry when queue_len > 20, (5) surface X-Served-From.
marta: Thanks all. Let's sync after PR review and schedule a 15m ops+sdk sync to confirm header semantics and rollout windows.
